newsitem.title: GERMANY: British Airways partners add German flight.
newsitem.headline: British Airways partners add German flight.

text.p: British Airways plc said it would increase flights between Germany and Britain in cooperation with partner airlines from March 30.
BA said it, subsidiary Deutsche BA and franchisees British Regional Airlines, CityFlyer Express and Maersk Air would offer 65 daily flights to and from 10 German cities.
British Regional Airlines would launch twice-daily Berlin to Manchester flights with a 49-seat Embraer 145 aircraft on August 18, a statement said.
The regional carrier would also take over the daily BA Hanover-Birmingham service from March 30, it added.
CityFlyer Express will fly from Duesseldorf, Cologne and Bremen to Gatwick several times a day.
Maersk will operate from Stuttgart twice a day and from Berlin once a day to Birmingham.

BA capacity between Frankfurt and London Gatwick will be increased with the use of a 168-seat Boeing 757 instead of a 139-seat 737 on the three times a day flight. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
